name: Kaeo Studios
street: 2nd Floor of Westgate Shopping Center, 94-366 Pupupani St #210
description: Kaeo Studios is a vibrant karaoke venue renowned for its inviting atmosphere and exceptional service. It offers private rooms equipped with high-quality sound systems, allowing guests to enjoy personalized singing experiences. The venue features a diverse song library, complimentary snacks and drinks, and a clean, spacious environment. Perfect for celebrations or casual nights out, Kaeo Studios stands out for its friendly staff and versatile amenities, making every visit memorable.
